sources.note: Toronto Metropolitan University's own Scholarships and Awards page (torontomu.ca, TMU Global / International Undergraduate Admissions). Read in full; contains the dedicated ISLA - Fall section under 'Prestigious entrance scholarships for September intake' plus the ISLA entry in the awards table. Page notes show updates dated May 26, 2026 and August 7, 2026.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on torontomu.ca, Toronto Metropolitan University's own domain, within its International Undergraduate Admissions finances section, and names Student Awards and Scholarships / International Enrolment Office as the ISLA-administering departments. It is the awarding body's own page, not an aggregator, news article, or mirror.
awarding_body.quote: Toronto Metropolitan University (TMU) is pleased to recognize the academic achievements of the first-year class upon admission to the university with over $7 million designated for entrance scholarship support. ... International Student Leadership Award (ISLA) ... Department: Student Awards and Scholarships/International Enrolment Office

deadline.detail: The page states the fall 2027 prestigious entrance scholarship application (which covers ISLA - Fall) opens on AwardSpring on November 2, 2026 and closes at an extended deadline of February 16, 2027, and explicitly excludes only ISLA - Winter from that deadline. This matches the record's deadline_label and deadline_date (2027-02-16) exactly. The deadline is in the future relative to the check date (12 October 2026) and belongs to the current fall 2027 intake cycle.
deadline.quote: The application for fall 2027 awards is available on AwardSpring from November 2, 2026 until the extended deadline to apply, February 16, 2027. ... The deadline noted above doesn't apply to the International Student Leadership Award (ISLA) - Winter.

eligibility.detail: Every distinct eligibility claim in the record is confirmed: international student status, starting the first year of a Canadian post-secondary institution on a full-time basis, being required to pay international tuition fees, a final admission average of at least 86% (an A, or equivalent), and a gap year no longer than one academic year. The page additionally requires a personal statement and specifies a full-time 4-year (or 5-year co-op) undergraduate degree at TMU; these are extra details, not contradictions of the record.
eligibility.quote: ISLA - Fall is for undergraduate international students enrolling in a post-secondary institution for the first time. Applicants must be starting their first year of a full-time 4-year (or 5 year co-op) undergraduate degree at TMU and paying international student fees. ... You must be an international student starting your first year of a Canadian post-secondary institution on a full-time basis. You must be required to pay international tuition fees. You must have a final admission average of at least 86%, an A, or an equivalent. You must write a personal statement for submission. If a gap year was taken, it must be no longer than one academic year.

funding.detail: The record's funding_type 'Entrance scholarship, non-renewable' is confirmed. The page states ISLA - Fall has a value of $10,000 CAD for up to 53 recipients, is entrance-only and non-renewable. It is a partial-value entrance award (a fixed $10,000 CAD), not a fully funded award, consistent with the record's wording.
funding.quote: ISLA - Fall 2027 has a value of $10,000 CAD for up to 53 recipients. This award is entrance-only and is non-renewable.

degree_levels.detail: Bachelor's level only. The page describes ISLA - Fall as being for undergraduate international students starting the first year of a full-time 4-year (or 5-year co-op) undergraduate degree at TMU, matching the record's degree_levels.
degree_levels.quote: ISLA - Fall is for undergraduate international students enrolling in a post-secondary institution for the first time. Applicants must be starting their first year of a full-time 4-year (or 5 year co-op) undergraduate degree at TMU and paying international student fees.
